proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The evaluation kernel is a prime ideal preserved by the actual state derivations. The finite necessary relations belong to it. The strict-transform ideal is its contraction after inverting tau.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: Transcendence degree gives dim Y = dim B + dim Y_generic and bounds the differential rank.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The three cubic equations and the combined two-coordinate linear solve reconstruct all eliminated state coordinates. Q_j are the complete reconstructed quartics, R_nu = Q_j - c_nu p_mu Q0, and all eighteen H relations are the complete differentiated, compensated polynomial sources.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: The explicit rational inverse transfers fibre dimension and differential rank to the retained state coordinates.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: Every regular exceptional-monomial quotient of an affine necessary identity belongs to the contracted ideal; every boundary component of the actual strict transform is included in the chart cover.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: Empty projective boundary makes the generic affine fibre proper and affine, hence finite.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: O: v=tau R; S: v=kappa delta Rbar, tau=kappa^2 delta; T: v=sigma Rbar, tau=sigma^2 beta_T. The first blowup has tau=sigma kappa; the S/T overlap satisfies delta beta_T=1. The five valuation regions are defined by n=ord(tau) and s_0=min ord(v_j), including s_0=infinity for v=0.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: Every reduced arc from the affine locus reaches one of the listed boundary charts.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: Each e_i satisfies a monic quadratic whose remaining terms are linear in e. Its tau-linear coefficient contains both the (3,1) and (1,2) source layers, and the tau^2 term is the exact remaining polynomial. The eight squarefree e monomials generate the algebra.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: The rational-graph closure defines a finite surjective cover, so every boundary arc has a lift after a finite extension.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: Complete support-gauge field numerators satisfy the incidence replacement identities and the two endpoint weighted degree bounds. Their regular Rees lifts preserve the actual ideal; the selected horizontal determinant is a unit.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: An actual boundary component carrying these fields dominates the ratio plane.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: Two full lifted fields are regular, preserve (tau), and have base determinant eta^2(eta-zeta+1) ell/(eta+1)^2, specializing to 3 ell/4. Formal flows identify the stable actual ideal with its transverse-fibre pullback.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: A transverse-fibre inclusion of a power of tau in the actual ideal transfers to a neighbourhood of the boundary point.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: Complete source membership I_selected subset J and a unit coefficient matrix modulo maximalideal times J imply J subset I_selected by Nakayama. The same argument applies to J^N.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: A power of tau in J excludes every reduced arc from the affine locus.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The exact implicit graph is substituted before taking weighted residual initial forms. The conormal identity is det(A) G_n - G_z adj(A) F_n=0. The required residual initials have only the origin as a common zero.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: The initial-form lemma and Nakayama place a power of the normal ideal in the necessary ideal.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The complete seven sources, twenty-one ordered first derivatives and sixty-three ordered second derivatives give the 91 by 6 matrix of relative first normal coefficients, with the printed parity and unit row normalization. All seven second-prolongation objects are reconstructed, including both ratio derivatives of their coefficients and the complete weighted components of weights eight and nine. The whole cone has zero source constant terms.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: These equations provide the complete cone family and the first coefficient module at its amplitude origin.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: Four complete polynomial identities A_flat n_i=d_i b express the coefficient vector of t2 Lambda through the 110 by 84 matrix. Three resultant polynomials have gcd a nonzero constant times r^188 q^218. The three fixed-degree canonical resultants use 2653 exact nodes each, 7959 altogether.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: Their coefficient ideal excludes rank deficiency on the stated amplitude and material open.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The axis maximal-minor ideals contain the printed nonzero monomials. The Lambda=0 resultants have the protected opposite signs. On t0 t1=-1/c_hyp, the three maximal-minor polynomials have a coefficient Bezout identity equal to one, with the stated nonzero denominator.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: Together with cyclic relabeling, these identities exclude all remaining nonzero amplitude loci.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: After four full implicit range equations, the residual ideal is J=(y1,y2) intersect (epsilon0,epsilon1,epsilon2), generated by the six products y_i epsilon_j. The post-implicit coefficient determinant is 9 q^12/(481036337152 r^9).
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: Complete family membership and the unit determinant identify J locally at every root, excluding arcs outside the full zero family.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The complete regularized R0 and H2 lie in (t,kappa), with normal determinant 32 r z w^3(x+z)^3; (x+z)^2=70m/3 is a unit.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: The two-normal ideal equality holds at all eight points.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The missing-row minors force t^2=-q whereas the full even sources force t^2=1/m. The paired-row factors satisfy 5 A_c-(-5 eta+4 zeta) B_c=9 q zeta.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: The sign 1+m q>0 and the protected factor identity exclude the critical inactive and paired supports.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: Masks 3,6,9,12,11,14 give unit ideals; masks 1,4 give tau^4, masks 2,8 give tau, mask 5 is excluded at eight roots, and masks 7,13,10,15 have the stated conic and wall ideal inclusions.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: The support cover and cyclic relabeling exhaust the single-range boundary.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: The complete divided W and h sources use the exact incidence corrections. The relative Schur identity holds for the full thirty-row conormal matrix. The two cyclic range determinants are -3 q k/(224 r m^2) and -32 q k/(1701 r m^2). The implicit graph places delta in the normal ideal and its fourth power in the necessary ideal.
proof_nodes.geometric_interface: The complete relative equations exclude the pure-axis arcs, including nilpotent normal directions.

proof_nodes.exact_mathematical_statement: All complete sources belong to the printed J9 and J10 graph ideals. The undivided identity (k+w^2) kappa x^2=(m/8) kappa C+... and the displayed tau identity hold in the relative ring.
